message.reasoning:
The user wants us to do three searches:

1) Search for a mystery novel (no specific title). In library location "New York City". Use library_search_books.

2) Then search on Google Books for same genre/maybe no title.

3) Then search on Open Library similarly.

We need to call each tool sequentially. The prompt says we can only return one JSON object per response. But we have multiple calls; maybe we should chain them? We might need to make separate responses for each step. However guidelines say we cannot output anything else than JSON objects when calling tools. So we will produce a single tool invocation at a time. Since they want all three searches, perhaps we could combine into one request? No, because each tool has different name. We can't pass multiple names. So likely we need to ask clarifying question about which search order? Wait instructions: "If you don't understand what the user means, ask clarification questions." They said they'd like to search in library NYC first, then Google Books, then Open Library. That seems clear enough. So we proceed.

But we may need to provide results from each search. Possibly we can perform the first search now, get results, then next etc. But as an assistant, we can only send one tool invocation at a time. After receiving result, we can decide next steps. Let's start with library_search_books. We'll set location="New York City", genre="mystery".

We'll omit title param since unknown.
